steps.name: s0-masks
argv:
import hashlib, subprocess, sys
PY = r"C:\banyan-farm\venv\Scripts\python.exe"
SC = r"C:\banyan-farm\fig-inpaint\inpaint_fruit.py"
D  = r"C:\banyan-farm\b01-bright\out"
def run(src, ellipse, prompt, negative, out, note):
    h = hashlib.sha256(open(src, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
    print("chained init %s sha256 %s" % (src, h), flush=True)
    rc = subprocess.call([PY, SC, "--init", src, "--init-sha256", h,
                          "--ellipse", ellipse,
                          "--prompt-file", prompt, "--negative-file", negative,
                          "--out", out, "--steps", "40", "--cfg", "7.5",
                          "--strength", "0.99", "--seed", "20260720",
                          "--pad-crop", "64", "--blur", "8", "--note", note])
    if rc:
        sys.exit(rc)
run(D + r"\01-cold-open-bright-i35b-s0.png", "378,655,48,54",
    r"C:\banyan-farm\fig-inpaint\leaf-prompt-r2.txt",
    r"C:\banyan-farm\fig-inpaint\leaf-negative-r2.txt",
    D + r"\b01-bright-s0-leaf.png",
    "Pass 2 of 3, seed 20260720. THE LEAF FILL, on the RELIT base rather than the founder's dusk plate -- that ordering is the whole point of this job. Ellipse 378,655,48,54 and every parameter carried over unchanged from ep2-b01-figmatte-0811; the prompts are its corrected r2 files (leaf prompt 1562bf0a, leaf negative 035b9da9), with `warm low sunlight` out of the fill and eleven glow terms in the negative. The count comes from geometry, not from a counting word. PROVISIONAL: not a pick, not canon, not published, not assembled.")
run(D + r"\b01-bright-s0-leaf.png", "462,848,34,36",
    r"C:\banyan-farm\fig-inpaint\prompt-r2.txt",
    r"C:\banyan-farm\fig-inpaint\negative-r2.txt",
    D + r"\b01-bright-s0.png",
    "Pass 3 of 3, seed 20260720. THE FIG, MATTE, on the relit and leaf-fixed frame. Ellipse 462,848,34,36, the same mask the 2026-08-10 fig inpaint used; prompts are the corrected r2 files (fig prompt db4a2502, fig negative 475a305a) -- `matte green skin` in the positive and the specular/glow terms in the negative, which is the load-bearing half. Non-overlapping with the leaf ellipse, so all three fixes read independently in one frame. PROVISIONAL: not a pick, not canon, not published.")

steps.name: publish
argv:
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b01-brightbase-figmatte"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
src = sorted(glob.glob("C:/banyan-farm/b01-bright/out/01-cold-open-bright-*")
             + glob.glob("C:/banyan-farm/b01-bright/out/b01-bright-s*"))
lines = []
for f in src:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    # Hash the COPY: what this records has to be the bytes that get committed.
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
    print("   ", os.path.basename(f), h[:16])
# newline="\n" is load-bearing: Windows text mode would leave a trailing \r on
# every filename and shasum -c could not open them.
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-b01-brightbase-figmatte.sha256"), "w",
          newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print("published", len(src), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
# 4 bases x (png + sidecar) = 8, plus 4 seeds x 2 mask passes x (png + mask
# png + sidecar) = 24. Fewer means the round wrote less than it promised.
raise SystemExit(0 if len(src) == 32 else 1)
